main_text.p: tationes, sed ad mores & actionem [?] usumque pertinebat, singulari quodā studio à Romanis excultā fuisse, vel hinc licet intelligatur, quòd in Iure civili præclarè & sapienter instituédotantopere elaborarit. Præclarè namq; Vlpianus, Iurisconsultos ait veram,ac non fucatam philosophiam amplexos esse. Siquidem (ut verisimè Cicero in Crasi persona scripsit) Moralis philosophia eodem habet fontes omnium disputationum suarum, qui Iure civili & legibus contīnentur. Unde illud eiusdem in libro de Oratore primo: Fremant,

page.notes: Long s read as plain s throughout. The « marks at the right edge are printed quotation marks for a quoted passage (Cicero, De Oratore I), not text, so they are left out. "ofdem" is printed as such; the expected word is "eodem" (printing error left as is). "actionem" first letter is a ligatured/ornate A, read with [?]. The "fa-" and "pienter" line breaks and the missing space in "instituédo tantopere" are as printed.
